chunks: And remember the brother of 'Ad, when he warned his people in Al-Ahqaf, though warners had come and gone before and after him: "Do not worship but Allah; indeed I fear for you the punishment of an awful day."

key_terms.أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ: That you do not worship but Allah
key_terms.بِالْأَحْقَافِ: In the dunes (a region in southern Arabia)

ai.seo_question: Who is the brother of 'Ad mentioned in the Quran and what was his message?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of prophetic mission, noting that Hud (AS) preached in Al-Ahqaf (southern Arabia) after numerous predecessors had already warned the 'Ad tribe, yet they remained heedless. The phrase 'no more warners' signifies the exhaustion of divine patience, serving as a cautionary precedent for the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) regarding the consequences of rejecting monotheism. This narrative reinforces the Shia emphasis on the universality of the message of Tawhid across different eras and tribes.
